expected.description: Populous: Reincarnated is the community infrastructure around Bullfrog's Populous: The Beginning: a matchmaker, map library, patches and a small but persistent multiplayer scene keeping the 1998 god game playable. It does not replace the original game; it gives owners a modern route into matches and community content.

qualityBar.verdict: Populous: Reincarnated clears the PlayBound Bar with a specific hook, honest trade-offs, and a version worth putting in front of players.

expected.thatOneThing: It turns an abandoned classic into an active shared hobby.

installSteps.text: Install your legally owned copy of Populous: The Beginning. Download the official PopRe Matchmaker, create a PopRe account, and use its Mods window to install compatible map packs.

faq.a: The PopRe tools are free, but they require a legally owned copy of Populous: The Beginning.

faq.q: Where should I install Populous: Reincarnated from?
faq.a: Install the original game, apply the recommended community patch if needed, then install the official PopRe Matchmaker.
Windows is the supported route for the original game and Matchmaker.
Yes. PopRe manages a large official community map-pack library; PlayBound links to that source instead of mirroring its files.

set.description: Populous: Reincarnated is the community matchmaker, map library and patch hub for Bullfrog's Populous: The Beginning. Its Windows tools are free, but you need your own copy of the original game. The community keeps its terrain-shaping RTS multiplayer alive with accounts, lobbies and custom maps.

systemRequirements.min: Windows PC with a working owned copy of Populous: The Beginning and an internet connection for online matches. PopRe does not publish numerical CPU, GPU or RAM requirements for its Matchmaker. The current Matchmaker download is about 5.3 MB; the original game's storage requirement is separate.
systemRequirements.recommended: No separate recommended hardware tier is published for the Matchmaker. Use hardware that runs your legally owned copy of Populous: The Beginning reliably.

min.notes: Requires an owned, installed copy of Populous: The Beginning and network access. PopRe does not publish numerical Matchmaker CPU, GPU, RAM or storage requirements.

recommended.notes: No developer-published recommended hardware tier for the Matchmaker.

qualityBar.verdict: The Matchmaker brings Populous players back to the same world, where one land bridge can undo an hour of planning.

set.thatOneThing: Build a land bridge to invade your neighbor, then watch them turn it into a route straight back to your shaman.

installSteps.text: Install your own legally obtained copy of Populous: The Beginning first. PlayBound's free Matchmaker download does not include the commercial base game.
Download the official PopRe Matchmaker (popmm.exe) from Populous: Reincarnated, run it, and create or sign in to a PopRe account. Use its own Mods window for supported community maps.

firstPlaySteps.text: Check that the Matchmaker finds your Populous: The Beginning installation. Join an available lobby or create a private match after signing in.

multiplayerGamingSteps.text: Use the official PopRe Matchmaker lobby to meet other players and choose a map. Every participant needs their own working base-game copy and PopRe account; this is not a PlayBound-hosted dedicated server.

faq.a: Its Matchmaker and community tools are free, but they require your own legally obtained copy of Populous: The Beginning.
Use the official Populous: Reincarnated Matchmaker download after installing the original game. PlayBound does not mirror the community's map packs or the commercial base game.
The official Matchmaker route is for Windows. No native macOS or Linux Matchmaker package is listed here.
PlayBound has not verified native controller input or a PlayBound Controls profile for the Matchmaker and original game. Keyboard and mouse remain the supported choice.
Yes. Sign in to PopRe's Matchmaker to find lobbies and community maps. PlayBound does not operate a dedicated server for it.

faq.q: How much space does it use?
faq.a: The Matchmaker executable is about 5.3 MB at the official download link. You also need the separate installed base game, whose size depends on your edition.
